expectations.text: The agent does not tag the off-by-one bug comment as a nit
expectations.evidence: Vacuously satisfied: the baseline has no nit concept, so it did not tag the off-by-one comment as a nit (it treated it as an ordinary fix).

expectations.text: The agent tags the rename-for-readability comment as a nit in the plan
expectations.evidence: The baseline has no nit concept and did not tag the rename comment as a nit; it presented it as an ordinary fix with no nit indicator.

expectations.text: The agent does not trigger the nits-only gate because at least one actionable comment is not a nit
expectations.evidence: Vacuously satisfied: the baseline has no nits-only gate, so it never triggered one; it proceeded to apply both comments.

expectations.text: The agent applies and commits both changes in auto mode without halting for a per-nit decision table
expectations.evidence: The baseline applied the off-by-one fix and the rename and committed both without halting — no decision table exists in the baseline workflow.
